  G1 0x9F1AC8  test ecx, ecx            ; ecx = [0xBDD838] singleton (never 0 in-game)
  G2 0x9F1ACC  cmp [ecx+0xC], 0         ; singleton +0xC = the ACTIVE INPUT DEVICE slot
              jne 0x9F1AF9 (skip)       ; camera write fires only when +0xC == 0
  edi = [ebp+0x10] (lParam)
  eax = [edi] >> 16   -> y              (high word)
  eax = (word)[edi]   -> x              (low word)
  0x9F1ADF: 0x5CA91A(singleton, x, y)   camera := mouse - (400,300)
The 16:16 packing is the Win32 MAKELPARAM(client-space mouse point); both
words arrive UNPACKED here (shr 16 / movzx word) — no additional sign
extension (client coords are unsigned 0..800/0..600).
Trigger: EVERY message of the mouse band while no +0xC device is active.
No threshold, no cadence counter, no interpolation VARIANT (funnel passes
VT_ERROR/missing).
